title: Approximation of finite extensions over a DVR completion with prescribed roots
statement: Let $A$ be a discrete valuation ring [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], with fraction field $F$ [def-pc-field-extension], and let $\pi$ be a uniformizer of $A$. Put $\widehat A=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}A/(\pi^n)$, its maximal-ideal-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], and $\widehat F=\operatorname{Frac}(\widehat A)$, with the canonical inclusion $F\hookrightarrow\widehat F$. Let $H/\widehat F$ be a finite field extension, meaning finite-dimensional. Assume either that $H/\widehat F$ is separable, or that $F$ has characteristic $p>0$ and $H$ is the compositum of a finite separable extension $M/\widehat F$ and $\widehat F[(\widehat\pi)^{1/p^r}]$ for some integer $r\geq0$ [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Here $\widehat\pi$ is the image of $\pi$, the roots and extensions are embedded in one common field, and compositum means their generated subfield. Then there exists a finite field extension $N/F$ and an isomorphism $\widehat F\otimes_FN\simeq H$ of $\widehat F$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. If $H/\widehat F$ is separable, $N/F$ may be chosen separable. No henselian, excellence, or residue-field hypothesis on $A$ is imposed.

source.place: Tag 09EJ, lemma-approximate-separable-extension, statement and proof; Tag 09F9, theorem-epp, completion paragraph applying 09EJ to a compositum with a prescribed p-power root of a uniformizer. The root is the same element before and after completion.

proof.text: Write $C=\widehat A$, $K=\widehat F$, and also write $\pi$ for its image in $C$. The completion is a DVR by [lem-weil-pbc-completion-of-dvr-is-dvr]. Its maximal ideal is $\pi C$ by [lem-weil-pbc-local-completion-local-ring]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-module-completion-complete] to $I=(\pi)$ and the module $A$: $C$ is complete for $\pi C$, and $C/\pi^nC\cong A/\pi^nA$ for every $n\ge1$. Thus each finite list of coefficients in $C$ can be lifted modulo $\pi^n$ to a list in $A$.

First let $E/K$ be any finite separable extension. Choose $\theta$ generating it by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-separable-extension-primitive-element], with monic minimal polynomial $P=T^d+\sum_{i<d}a_iT^i$ as in [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Replacing $\theta$ by $\pi^s\theta$ replaces $a_i$ by $\pi^{s(d-i)}a_i$; choose $s$ so these finitely many coefficients lie in $C$. This preserves the generated field and separability. Put $B=C[\theta]\subset E$. Division by the monic $P$ identifies $B=C[T]/(P)$: a remainder of degree less than $d$ vanishing at $\theta$ must be zero over $K$. By [lem-weil-pbc-monic-quotient-free], $B$ is free of rank $d$ over $C$, with basis $1,\theta,\ldots,\theta^{d-1}$.

source.place: 09EJ, primitive element, scaling, and monogenic algebra paragraph

proof.text: The domain $B$ is Noetherian, local, and complete at its maximal ideal $\mathfrak n$ by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-over-complete-local-product]. It is integral over $C$ by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-algebra-is-integral]. Hence [lem-weil-pbc-integral-extension-dimension] gives $\dim B\le1$ and $\mathfrak n\cap C=\pi C$. Since $0\ne\pi\in\mathfrak n$ and $B$ is a domain, $(0)\subsetneq\mathfrak n$ is a prime chain, so $\dim B=1$. Separability of $\theta$ gives $P^{\prime}(\theta)\ne0$: evaluate a Bezout identity for $P,P^{\prime}$ over $K$ at $\theta$. Apply [lem-sfb-complete-local-domain-root-perturbation] in $B$, with $t=\pi$, $a=\theta$, and $c=1$, to obtain a sufficient precision $n$. Lift the $d$ lower coefficients of $P$ modulo $\pi^nC$ to $A$, retaining leading coefficient $1$, to form $P_1\in A[T]$. For $Q=P_1-P$ the lemma gives a root $\beta\in B$ of $P_1$ with $\beta-\theta\in\pi B$.

source.place: 09EJ, complete local domain and application of 09EI; 0325 (algebra-lemma-quotient-complete-local), 00GK (algebra-lemma-finite-is-integral), 00OJ (algebra-lemma-integral-dim-up)

proof.text: For every $i<d$, $\beta^i\equiv\theta^i\pmod{\pi B}$, by factoring their difference. Thus $1,\beta,\ldots,\beta^{d-1}$ span $B/\pi B$. Nakayama [lem-weil-pbc-nakayama-local-generators], over the local ring $C$ with maximal ideal $\pi C$, says that they span $B$. Evaluation at $\beta$ therefore gives a surjection $C[T]/(P_1)\to B$. Both sides are free of rank $d$ by [lem-weil-pbc-monic-quotient-free]. In their indicated bases this surjection is a square matrix; modulo $\pi$ it is invertible, so its determinant is a unit of $C$ and its adjugate gives an inverse. Localizing at $\pi$ yields $K[T]/(P_1)\cong E$, taking the class of $T$ to $\beta$. Here $B[1/\pi]=K[\theta]=E$.

source.place: 09EJ, map Phi, Nakayama, and equal-rank argument; 00DV (algebra-lemma-NAK)

proof.text: The polynomial $P_1$ is irreducible over $K$, since its quotient is the field $E$. It is also irreducible over $F$: a factorization into positive-degree polynomials over $F$ would remain such over $K$. Put $N_0=F[T]/(P_1)$; it is a degree-$d$ field extension. The tensor universal property [lem-weil-pbc-algebra-tensor-pushout-universal-property] identifies $K\otimes_FN_0$ with $K[T]/(P_1)$ by $c\otimes[g(T)]\mapsto[cg(T)]$, with inverse taking $c$ to $c\otimes1$ and $T$ to $1\otimes[T]$. Thus $K\otimes_FN_0\cong E$. Over $K$, $P_1$ is the minimal polynomial of the generator $\beta$ of the separable extension $E/K$, so $P_1^{\prime}\ne0$. The derivative over $F$ is consequently nonzero as well. By [lem-trf-irreducible-separable-derivative] $P_1$ is separable over $F$, and [lem-trf-simple-separable-field-extension] makes $N_0/F$ separable. Taking $E=H$ proves the separable case.

source.place: 09EJ, final polynomial quotient and field descent; 09H0 (fields-lemma-irreducible-polynomials) and 09H9 (fields-lemma-separably-generated-separable)

proof.text: Now suppose $\operatorname{char}F=p>0$ and $H=M K(\alpha)$, where $\alpha^{p^r}=\pi$ is the prescribed root in $H$. Set $q=p^r$, $L=F(\alpha)$, and $L_K=K(\alpha)$. Apply [lem-sbc-dvr-uniformizer-root-algebra] to $A$ and $C$ with exponent $q>0$: the algebras $A[T]/(T^q-\pi)$ and $C[T]/(T^q-\pi)$ are domains. After inverting $\pi$, they are finite-dimensional domains over $F$ and $K$, hence fields (multiplication by a nonzero element is an injective endomorphism of a finite-dimensional vector space and is therefore surjective). Evaluating $T$ at $\alpha$ embeds these fields into $H$, with images $L$ and $L_K$. Their bases from [lem-weil-pbc-monic-quotient-free] have $q$ elements. As in step 5, the tensor universal property gives $K\otimes_FL\cong L_K$, sending $1\otimes\alpha$ to this very $\alpha$. Both $L/F$ and $L_K/K$ are purely inseparable: the $q$th power of any rational expression in $\alpha$ lies in the base field by Frobenius. This includes $r=0$, when $q=1$ and $L=F$.

source.place: 09F9 (theorem-epp), completion paragraph and the prescribed root; 09EV (lemma-pull-root-uniformizer), root algebra argument

proof.text:
Apply steps 2--5 to $E=M$ and embed the resulting separable $N_0/F$ into $M$ using $n\mapsto$ the image of $1\otimes n$ under $K\otimes_FN_0\cong M$. By [lem-weil-pbc-separable-purely-inseparable-linear-disjoint], the multiplication map $N_0\otimes_FL\to H$ is injective. Its image is a finite-dimensional domain over $F$, hence a field by the same multiplication argument as in step 6, and therefore equals the compositum $N=N_0L$. In particular $N/F$ is finite. Apply that same cited node over $K$ to $M$ and $L_K$: multiplication identifies $M\otimes_KL_K$ with $ML_K=H$, since its image is again a finite-dimensional field containing both factors. Finally the tensor universal property gives
$$K\otimes_FN\cong (K\otimes_FN_0)\otimes_K(K\otimes_FL)\cong M\otimes_KL_K\cong H.$$
The first map sends $c\otimes(n\otimes l)$ to $(c\otimes n)\otimes(1\otimes l)$; its inverse sends $(c\otimes n)\otimes(d\otimes l)$ to $cd\otimes(n\otimes l)$. Balancing verifies that these maps are well defined and mutually inverse. In particular the construction uses the original $\pi$ and its prescribed root throughout.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q11-8b08ee5f4 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read Stacks more-algebra.tex: 09EI lemma-krasner in full, 09EJ lemma-approximate-separable-extension in full, and the 09F9 theorem-epp completion paragraph. The item's two cases (separable; char p compositum with K̂(π^{1/p^r})) match the source, and the statement is unchanged. The new node lem-sfb-complete-local-domain-root-perturbation is 09EI with Noetherian made explicit and precision in a fixed parameter t. It is true: dim 1 gives m=√(t), so m^k⊂(t), and the Stacks proof already works with π=t. I tested it on k[[u]] with a non-unit derivative, on the singular domain k[[u^2,u^3]] with T^2−u^4, and on Artin–Schreier; T^p at 0 is correctly excluded. Grep over the DAG finds no duplicate: the henselian simple-root, henselian Krasner and normed Krasner nodes are field-valued, not roots inside B. The node is statement-only, self-contained and strictly smaller than the item. Steps 1–7 each check against the cited statements: completion is a DVR with C/π^n≅A/π^n; the integral primitive element gives B=C[T]/(P) free of rank d; B is local, complete, of dimension 1, with P'(θ)≠0 by Bezout, which meets every hypothesis of the root lemma; Nakayama over C plus the determinant argument give C[T]/(P1)≅B; P1 is irreducible and separable over F; the root algebra for q=p^r is purely inseparable; linear disjointness is applied twice, then the tensor associativity. Edge cases d=1, r=0, A already complete, mixed characteristic and imperfect residue field are all fine. I accept the tool uses completion-of-dvr-is-dvr, finite-over-complete-local-product, integral-extension-dimension and sbc-dvr-uniformizer-root-algebra. Batch 5: lem-trf-irreducible-separable-derivative and lem-trf-simple-separable-field-extension are status-mathlib generic field-theory leaves with empty proof_deps. They are not part of the trace formula or Poincaré duality statements or proofs, so the citations are OK. Minor: the report mentions a citations.json that is not in the commit.
